question: Which of the following ratios is the greatest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the given ratios into approximate decimals to directly compare them in one go:

28 : 74 ≈ 0.37

45 : 85 ≈ 0.52

33 : 72 ≈ 0.45

40 : 53 ≈ 0.75

Since 0.75 is by far the highest value, 40 : 53 is the greatest ratio.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 : 53.**
